{{Quote|There goes another one."<br />"Hold your fire.|Chief gunnery officer Lieutenant Hija and Gunnery Captain Bolvan|audio=Hija-Bolvan.flac|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Chief gunnery officer''', also called '''gunnery chief''', was an [[Assignment/Legends|assignment]] given on [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing shuttles]]. The position was also on [[Y-4 Transport]]s and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]], being known as '''weapons officer''' in the second and third cases. In the Imperial Navy, under the [[Gunnery captain/Legends|gunnery captain's]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]], the [[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] managed the Star Destroyer's main weaponry. On ''Sentinel''-class landing [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], they handled the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] mounted on the ships' main [[Trooper/Legends|troop]] compartments. For pirate ships, they were in charge of drills, supervising weapon and shield maintenance, and commanding tactical situations, and were also responsible for ship-wide security and boarding teams for privateer and other, larger vessels. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Niclara Varnillian]], [[Reagal Eron]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hija/Legends|Hija]] all served as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] chief gunnery officers.

==Description==
{{Quote|That afternoon I requested reassignment to the navy and I've been happy here ''[as chief gunnery officer aboard the ''Eradicator'']'' ever since.|Reagal Eron|<ref name="This Guy">{{WEGCite|story=This Guy Just Doesn't Care|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters}}</ref>}}
[[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]],<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> also referred to as gunnery chief,<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> was an [[Assignment/Legends|assignment]] on [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]], which could be given to a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. Only one chief gunnery officer could serve on a given [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="BTM" /> Those assigned to the role managed the main weaponry of the vessel under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Gunnery captain/Legends|gunnery captain]]<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> and wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Imperial Navy crewman]]'s [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]].<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:Bolvan-Hija-ANH.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A chief gunnery officer (right) serving under a gunnery captain (left)]]
The chief gunnery officer, also known as gunnery chief, was a position on [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing shuttles]] as well.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> Interchangeably called head gunnery officer in the role,<ref name="FF 39">{{FactFile|39|SEN 1-2|''Sentinel''-class Imperial Landing Craft}}</ref> they were the head gunner and part of a crew consisting of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], co-pilot, and two other gunners. The gunnery chiefs handled the four [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] mounted on each side of the ''Sentinel''-class landing [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle's]] main [[Trooper/Legends|troop]] compartment, while the other gunners handled the vessel's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]], and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]].<ref name="SETSB">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> [[Y-4 Transport]]s also used chief gunnery officers as part of the command crew, along with the pilot, and a second gunnery officer. The chief gunner handled the [[Transport/Legends|transports']] forward weaponry, which included two fire-linked laser [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] and a recessed concussion-missile launcher with a magazine of six missiles. T-4 Transports saw usage by the Empire, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], as well as civilians, and went on to be popularly used by [[Zsinj's Empire]].<ref name="EGVV" />

Chief gunnery officer, or weapons officer, was also used on [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] vessels, having responsibility for drills, supervising weapon and shield maintenance, and commanding tactical situations during actions. When the pirates proceeded to boarding target ships, the chief gunnery officers would use threatening laser cannon fire to make sure their targets would quickly heel, alongside ion cannons and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to bring in prizes. On [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] and other larger ships, chief gunnery officers were also responsible for ship-wide security and boarding teams.<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>

==History==
===Lieutenant Hija===
{{Quote|Prepare for an orbital bombardment of Falleen&mdash;centering on the research facility, and everything within 40 kilometers.|Darth Vader, to Lieutenant Hija|<ref name="TLE">{{WEGCite|story=The Lesser Evil|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
[[File:Hija-ANH.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Lieutenant Hija served as the chief gunnery officer aboard the Star Destroyer ''Devastator''.]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ANH" /> Lieutenant [[Hija/Legends|Hija]] served the Imperial Navy as the chief gunnery officer aboard<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="ANH" /> [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], and managed the Star Destroyer's main weaponry.<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> Around [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]],<ref name="Note">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' dates the [[bombardment of Falleen]] to ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project, which occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered the [[Bombardment of Falleen|bombardment]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] in order to stop a [[Flesh-eating bacterium|bacterial plague]] that was spreading from a [[Bacteriological research outpost|laboratory]] on the planet.<ref name="TLE" />

[[0 BBY/Legends|Around seven years later]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] from the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|battle of Tatooine]] until the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which includes the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]], to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|battle of Tatooine]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Hija, still serving aboard the ''Devastator'', spotted an [[Class-6 escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] jettisoned from the captured [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], one of the Alliance's [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]].<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> However, his<ref name="CSWECITEII42">{{CSWECite|II|42|Hija, Lieutenant}}</ref> superior, Gunnery Captain [[Bolvan/Legends|Bolvan]], ordered him not to fire because the Star Destroyer's gunnery [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] indicated that no lifeforms were aboard. The [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], in truth, contained the Rebel [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], in possession of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|stolen plans]] for the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="EP4NOVEL" />

===Other chief gunnery officers===
{{Quote|I sure as tundin' didn't sign up to kick Rebel butt in a ''pink'' ship.|A chief gunnery officer expressing disdain at new assignment aboard a havod-refurbished ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer|<ref name="J10" />}}
[[File:Niclara_Varnillian.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Niclara Varnillian, who was the chief gunnery officer aboard the Star Destroyer ''Pulsar'' in 0 BBY]]
The Human [[Niclara Varnillian]] became chief gunnery officer on the ''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer [[Pulsar (Star Destroyer)|''Pulsar'']]<ref name="WBC">{{JournalCite|8|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref> that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC" /> between the Empire's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="WBC" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC2">According to {{JournalCite|8|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}, the [[Skirmish on Ord Mantell (3 ABY)|firefight]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] took place one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Varnillian was on leave on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] when she recognized Alliance [[operative]]s [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Anson Blazer]] and Lieutenant [[Alton Lochner]]. Along with Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], Varnillian botched her attempt to capture the pair, resulting in a [[Skirmish on Ord Mantell (3 ABY)|firefight]] that led to several Imperial soldier and civilian [[Death/Legends|fatalities]]. After all but two of the Alliance operatives escaped, Varnillian returned to the ''Pulsar'' and was demoted for the failure.<ref name="WBC" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Missions-1">''[[Star Wars Missions 1: Assault on Yavin Four]]'' and the next three ''Star Wars Missions'' books tell a continuous story that starts the day after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but before the start of the [[Yavin blockade]] proper, placing them in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a [[unidentified Imperial lieutenant (Liquidator)|lieutenant]] served as the chief gunnery officer aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Liquidator (Imperial-class)|''Liquidator'']]. He answered to Captain [[Skeezer]], who was tasked to go to the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] to investigate why the Star Destroyer got no message from the Death Star. Neither the ''Liquidator''{{'s}} commanding officer, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terno]], nor anybody else aboard the Destroyer knew the Death Star was destroyed in the Battle of Yavin. The lieutenant was among those dispatched with Skeezer in a long-range modified [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|Carrack cruiser]]. He answered Skeezer's query about which of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of Yavin could support life with his understanding of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], [[Yavin 8/Legends|8]], and [[Yavin 13/Legends|13]]. Skeezer decided to take the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] to Yavin 4, being the closest one, before the cruiser was discovered by the Alliance presence at the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on the moon and the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] shot the cruiser down. In the subsequent battle, Skeezer's forces were defeated while he was captured by the Alliance.<ref name="Star Wars Missions 1: Assault on Yavin Four">''[[Star Wars Missions 1: Assault on Yavin Four]]''</ref>

At some point between 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Eron timeframe note">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that period to between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> [[Reagal Eron]] served as the chief gunnery officer of the Star Destroyer [[Eradicator (Imperial-class)|''Eradicator'']]. Eron was happy with that assignment, and at one point recounted serving as the [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]] of Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Isis (Governor)|Isis]], and witnessing [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] collect his [[Bounty/Legends|reward]] for the capture of pirate [[Feldrall Okor]]. Eron considered the chief gunnery officer assignment to be far better than serving as Governor Isis's adjutant.<ref name="This Guy" />

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Math-GrS">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}} establishes that the refurbishment of a group of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] with [[Havod/Legends|havod]] alloy plating took place by the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 37:4:19, which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> a chief gunnery officer was assigned to serve aboard one of 100 [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] which had been refurbished with [[Havod/Legends|havod]] alloy plating. As the refurbishing made the ships a reddish color, the chief gunnery officer was one of many who subsequently requested transferring out of their assignments aboard the refurbished Destroyers.<ref name="J10" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FromtheAdventuresofLukeSkywalker.png|thumb|right|250px|Alan Dean Foster's novelization of ''A New Hope'', which was the chief gunnery officer's first appearance]]
The position of chief gunnery officer first appeared in the [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> Hija's scene also appeared in the film itself, which saw release in [[1977]].<ref name="ANH" /> In the novel,<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> which was ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]],<ref name="ANH novel SE">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]], [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] foreword by [[George Lucas]]</ref> Hija is referred to as one of Bolvan's chief gunnery officers,<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> before only one such officer was established to serve on the ''Devastator'' by the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="SWEHija">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{C|''"Hija, Lieutenant"''}}</ref> released [[June 30]], [[1998]].<ref name="San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives">{{ThisWeek|-BZX-WxjhFE|San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives, Brand New LEGO Art, and More!|sw_url=video/san-diego-comic-con-exclusives-brand-new-lego-art-and-more}}</ref> On [[September 14]] of the same year,<ref name="Copyright">{{WebCite|url=https://publicrecords.copyright.gov/detailed-record/voyager_11750138|text=Star Wars :behind the magic.|work=the [[Wikipedia:United States Copyright Office|U.S. Copyright Office Public Records System]]|archivedate=20251007153634}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' repeated that only one chief gunnery officer served on the ''Devastator,''<ref name="BTM" /> and [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' mentioned the same thing.<ref name="CSWECITEII42" />

[[March 19]], [[1996]]'s<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=Essential-Guide-Vehicles-Vessels-Star/dp/034539299X|text=The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels (Star Wars)}}</ref> ''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' also included the chief gunnery officer, and interchangeably called the role chief gunner. This article makes no assumptions about if chief gunner is another official [[in-universe]] designation.<ref name="EGVV" /> On [[January 21]], [[2014]],<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/147|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #147}}</ref> "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|The Devious Neimoidians Revealed]]," an article written for the [[Star Wars Insider 147|147th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, coined the term of "[[Chief Gunner/Legends|Chief Gunner]]" for [[Jull Dremon]], a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]]<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|147|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Devious Neimoidians Revealed}}</ref> who was onscreen and serving the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref> This article does not automatically assume the positions are the same role, nor does it assume that any other usage of "chief gunner" in ''[[Star Wars]]'' media is a reference to a chief gunnery officer if not literally specified as such. 

In [[May]] of that year, a chief gunnery officer also appeared in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 10]], and was called a "gunnery chief," which is the only time this article assumes that a reference to a "gunnery chief" in ''Star Wars'' media is a reference to a chief gunnery officer.<ref name="J10" /> The [[1997]] sourcebook ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'' noted that the chief gunnery officer position was also known as "weapons officer" aboard pirate and privateer vessels.<ref name="PP" /> While the [[Weapons officer/Legends|weapons officer]] term was coined in [[1984]]'s ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'',<ref name="Guide To SW Universe">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> this article does not treat the positions as globally the same in-universe, and treats only the weapons officers mentioned in ''Pirates and Privateers'' as confirmed chief gunnery officers as that source directly says that pirate and privateer vessels recognize both terms for the position.<ref name="PP" /> On [[September 25]], [[2002]],<ref name="Date">{{FFdates|39}}</ref> the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 39|39th issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' identified "chief gunnery officer" as "head gunnery officer."<ref name=" FF 39" />
